programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E5
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E22
programme.desc: Endora, hoping to break up her daughter's marriage, superimposes Samantha's face on a print entitled "Maid of Salem:" the print is dated 1690. Darrin buys the print and then begins to worry about the difference between Samantha's age and his own. With Endora planting seeds of doubt at every turn, Darrin visualizes himself as a doddering old man, while Samantha retains her youthful appearance. Everyone, including Larry Tate and the doctor from whom Darrin seeks advice, fails to realize what is troubling him. Then, in a nearby park, Darrin overhears two squirrels to which Endora has given voice talk about their dif-ferences in age. Endora finally admits to Samantha that she can age along with Darrin. Samantha, after telling Darrin she never posed for the picture, tells him that her mother is to blame for their problem. She assures him that they will grow old together, but being in love will never note the difference. As insurance, Samantha uses witchcraft to make the "Maid of Salem" disappear.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E23

Joe Harvey calls a meeting at his home to discuss plans for doing something about it. Darrin makes an ad for a mass rally at the school auditorium to force City Hall to put a traffic light on the corner. However, Samantha has trouble getting Endora to return the traffic signals she has collected. Endora even brings a London bobby to the Stephens' living room. The bobby, of course, has disappeared by the time Gladys Kravitz brings her husband to see him. At the rally, the Mayor tells his constituents a traffic light is unnecessary. However, using her witchcraft, Samantha has the Mayor and his limousine so tied up in a traffic jam that he is convinced a traffic signal is necessary. Endora, as a final touch, brings a modern traffic signal to the Stephens home for the victory celebration. Gladys sees it, but by the time she brings Abner, Samantha makes Endora cause it to vanish.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E24
programme.desc: Samantha tells Endora she doesn't have time for a dress-fitting. Endora solves Samantha's problem by transforming herself into En-Sam, identical to Samantha. Gladys Kravitz, who has seen En-Sam with Bob, is sure the Stephens home is about to break up. All of En-Sam's efforts to break with Bob fail. Bob is determined to have a showdown with Darrin over Samantha. Samantha tells Darrin that Bob has fallen in love with Endora. Endora, still En-Sam, arrives and Bob thinks En-Sam and Samantha are identical twins. Although Endora promises to give Bob Up, Samantha, knowing her mother, is not sure what she will do.

Darrin becomes involved in Pleasure's affairs after he helps her move in. One night, Pleasure wakes up the Stephens. programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dangerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom. But what is the truth behind the killers of the natural world? Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Nature's Weirdest
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most – scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on. Each one finds its own way to exploit and conserve the available food and water in a daily struggle for survival.

programme.title: Marine Mammals
programme.desc: From giant sperm whales to dramatic humpbacks and playful dolphins, we can't resist the endless charms of marine mammals.

programme.title: Wild Waters
programme.desc: From the highest mountain to the lowest valley, rivers and streams are freshwater highways, de-livering essential life blood to all kinds of wildlife. From some of the most iconic species like the otter and the trout, to the unfamiliar and elusive, like the delicate harvest mouse. Life on these freshwater freeways can be tough, and for many it's a constant battle just to stay alive. Take a break from the oceans and turn to the rivers and streams, home to the real wild waters of the nat-ural world.

programme.title: Spots and Stripes
programme.desc: Whether spots or stripes, markings can be used for anything from communication to cooling. What look like standout fashion statements to us can help animals vanish completely into a landscape. The design possibilities are endless, and vary to suit the terrain and geography. Whatever their remarkable uses, spots and stripes adorn some of the most iconic animals in the natural world. Camouflage or decoration, we can thank both spots and stripes for handing these creatures their unique and majestic beauty.

programme.title: Colours of Nature
programme.desc: From subtle to shocking, colour enhances the beauty of the natural world. Colour is a language to most living things, whether as a warning, camouflage or a come on. But there's more to colour than just pigment. Colours define how many animals behave, how they mate and how they inter-act with one another. For us the beautiful and varied shades of the animal kingdom form a spec-tacular kaleidoscope of colours. With all the diversity in the world, sit back and enjoy all the col-ours of the animal kingdom.

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won't find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy's Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: mareTV: Denmarks Limfjord
programme.desc: Wide open spaces, water, meadows: The Limfjord stretches through Jutland in Denmark in countless bays, canals and sounds. Mighty water castles, country palaces and magnificent monasteries are enthroned on its shores. It is a rather lonely area, even in high summer it is quiet. This is probably why the people here are so friendly and sociable. Birte, Silla and Bo cycle to their fjord garden project in the harbor of the town of Løgstør to harvest mussels, oysters and seaweed. They think gardening is best in a club. Luckily, Silla, a resourceful tinkerer, has just made another ingenious invention: the mussel washing machine. Cruising the narrow Næssund, a branch of the Limfjord, is the Næssund Ferry, the smallest and oldest car ferry in the area. New on board, and the first and only woman on this ship, is deckhand Lilian Kohler. She is "girl for everything", but wants more, because Lilian is a trained navigator. She is magically drawn to the bridge, but the old captain doesn't think much of retiring ashore.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Between Finland and Sweden
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest ocean in the world and first evolved after the last Ice Age. We think we know everything about it, yet still it has many surprises in store. Wind and waves still shape the shores of the Baltic Sea to this day. The third episode takes us to the Bay of Bothnia. More than double the size of the Netherlands, it is the most unknown region of the Baltic Sea. In the winter, the Baltic Sea freezes over at a length of 300 kilometres. In this 1-metre-thick ice tank, the third species of seal - alongside the grey seal and common seal - copes well with the Baltic Sea. The ringed seal is perfectly adapted to the Arctic winter and carves out breathing holes into the ice. More than 10,000 of the animals still live between Sweden and Finland. The Bay of Bothnia only has a salt content of just 1%, which is why it freezes quicker than other regions of the Baltic Sea. Many rivers disembogue here and “sweeten” the sea. The Tornio is the longest natural river in Europe. It forms the border between Sweden and Finland. Even when frost is severe, the Kukkolaforsen rapids in Sweden never freeze over, otters go hunting here. When it gets dark in the winter, solar winds conjure colourful light effects in the Baltic Sea sky. The Aurora Borealis can be seen in the northern regions of the Baltic Sea as of mid-October. The coast of Lapland is also the home of the reindeer. The Sami's, reindeer breeders, bring their herds in winter to the Baltic Sea, as the snow is not as deep here as it is further inland and the animals have better access to lichens and mosses. When Lapland's coast is still frozen, 300 kilometres further south in the Kvarken Archipelago, a special spectacle takes place. Millions of fish head for the coast. Barrier beaches prevent them from reaching the coastal lagoons. They can only spawn where the water is salt-free.

This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: THE GREEN WIDOW
programme.desc: The Green Widow focuses on Mary Ellen Samuels, a woman whose lust for money and drugs led her to arrange for the 1988 murder of her husband, a successful Hollywood cameraman. Worried that authorities were catching up to her, she also arranged for the murder of the hitman. Meanwhile, as investigators continued to gather evidence against her, she went on a yearlong, $500,000 shopping spree with the insurance money from her husband's death. She bought a brand new Porsche and a condo in Cancun, Mexico. With the hit man dead, little forensic evidence, and no eyewitnesses, prosecutors faced an uphill battle in their attempts to secure a double murder conviction against her.

programme.title: ROOTS OF THE ROCKIES
programme.desc: Kolyn Boyd and Lindsey Granger dig beneath the postcard-perfect landscapes of Colorado to uncover a narrative of sacred homelands, the untold legacy of Black cowboys, and the rugged survival of mountain pioneers. The journey begins at the confluence of the South Platte River and Cherry Creek—the sacred heart of downtown Denver—where Rick Williams of People of Sacred Land reveals the 11,000-year history of the Cheyenne, Arapaho, and Ute nations. Facing the 'hard truths' of history, Mayor Mike Johnston discusses the city's commitment to recognition, including the creation of the first American Indian cultural embassy. The exploration continues at the Black American West Museum, where the hosts rediscover the 'lost brand' of the frontier: the Black cowboys and Exodusters who made up one in three cattle drivers in the Old West. Transitioning from the plains to the peaks, the team heads to Telluride and Winter Park to experience the evolution of mountain life. From the 19th-century 'Norwegian snowshoes' used by miners to high-speed snowmobile treks through the Silverton Caldera, the episode captures the adrenaline of the Rockies' gold-mining past. The journey concludes with a taste of the land, from traditional chokecherry puddings to a six-course Creole menu at The Tunnel—a modern speakeasy that honors the secret history of Prohibition-era Colorado.

The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima

Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Surtaaj of Punjab
programme.desc: “Surtaaj of Punjab” is a vibrant Punjabi musical reality show on GTC Punjabi, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Punjab through its aspiring singers. Hosted by Saira, Anmol Aulakh and Gurjeet Singh, the show features a diverse range of talent competing for the coveted title. Renowned music directors Gurmeet Singh and Jaidev Kumar (Music Director) along with celebrated singer Jyotika Tangri, serve as the esteemed judges, guiding contestants on a musical journey. Each episode is a celebration of talent, emotion, and the magic of Punjabi music.

She gets involved with Kim Bon, the man next door that has been chasing after a huge conspiracy and involuntarily becomes a member of Kingsbag, a special organization within the National Intelligence Service(NIS). programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Parikrama
programme.desc: A journey to experience the most revered religious sites of India. A spiritual – travel series which unfolds untold stories and takes its viewers on a devotional journey."

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: India Post
programme.desc: The most visible and relatable aspect of a postal system is the postman. Behind this individual, however, there is a massive, intricate organisation that makes it possible for him to bring us joy, hope, news and so much more. We discover the various modes a letter or a package takes through the bowels, nerves and sinews of this system, the technological innovations and igneous processes that make deliveries simpler, faster, more reliable and cost efficient which makes something sent from some of most inaccessible areas in the world reach the metros after raversing the length and breadth of the entire nation to showcase how the world's largest postal network makes home delivery possible.

programme.title: Wellbeing behind the wheel – The new Bentley Azure Range
programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz

Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: Da quando suo padre è morto, Maurizio è sommerso dai debiti ma decide di nascondere tutto alla moglie e al figlio che sta per sposarsi. Un mare di debiti, bugie e malintesi nella commedia esilarante con Maurizio Battista e Claudia Pandolfi.

programme.title: Stressati
programme.desc: Marco e Dado sono amici dai tempi del liceo e lavorano nella redazione di un giornale satirico. Dado ha successo con le donne mentre Marco ha molti problemi, fin quando non arrivano Adele e Maria a cambiare le loro vite.

programme.title: Un Piccolo Grande Eroe
programme.desc: La storia di Alan, adolescente malato di poliomelite che desidera cavalcare e ha come mito personale il west e i cowboy. Dai racconti dell'australiano Allan Marshall, un film sulla giovinezza e su quanti ancora ne custodiscono in cuore il segreto.

programme.title: I Racconti Del Cuscino
programme.desc: Nagiko, cresciuta dal padre nel culto di una tradizione che vede il corpo femminile come fonte d'ispirazione, comincia a praticare con i suoi amanti la scrittura sul corpo. Attraverso quest'ultima cercherà vendetta nei confronti di un perverso editore.

programme.title: 11 Settembre
programme.desc: Un gruppo di 5 persone si trova intrappolato in un ascensore nella Torre Nord del World Trade Center l'undici settembre. Senza mai abbandonare la speranza, cerca di liberarsi e fuggire prima che accada l'impensabile.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Danny Trejo in un adrenalinico action. Il gangster Erik Vasquez cerca di diventare il leader assoluto della malavita messicana. Sparatorie, potere, denaro, avidità e tradimenti nella storia dell'ascesa e della caduta del primo signore della droga di origine americana in Messico.

programme.title: Premonitions
programme.desc: L'agente speciale dell'FBI Joe Merriwether non riesce a fare luce su una misteriosa catena di delitti. Ingaggia così un suo ex collaboratore in pensione, il medico psicanalista John Clancy, allo scopo di risolvere il caso.

programme.title: Shrapnel
programme.desc: Un ex marine (Jason Patric) e il suo vecchio compagno di guerra (Cam Gigandet) si infiltrano nel pericoloso mondo di un cartello messicano per scoprire la verità sulla scomparsa della figlia. Riusciranno a sopravvivere e a fare giustizia?

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: L'arrivo
programme.desc: Il radioastronomo Zane Zaminsky crede di aver rilevato un rumore cosmico che prova l'esistenza di un'intelligenza extraterrestre. LA sua disperata ricerca di una risposta lo porta a scoprire che gli alieni sono già sulla Terra e che si preparano a conquistarla.

programme.title: The Canyons
programme.desc: Christian è un ventenne ricco, prepotente e manipolatore. La fidanzata Tara è, invece, una ex modella che pur di stare con Christian calpesta propria dignità. Le loro vite saranno cambiate da un incontro sessuale che li condurrà in un percorso di violenza, inganni e paranoia.

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: Awake Anestesia cosciente
programme.desc: Sebbene il suo corpo sia completamente paralizzato dall'anestesia, Clay rimane consapevole per tutta la durata dell'intervento, sperimentando così la 'consapevolezza intraoperatoria'. Questa esperienza, tra il delirio e la realtà, avrà ripercussioni nella sua vita perché emergeranno segreti nascosti.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Se permetti non parlarmi di bambini!
programme.desc: Da quando si è separato, Gabriel non ha fatto altro che pensare a sua figlia Sofia e a trascorrere del tempo con lei. Le altre donne non sembrano interessargli nemmeno. Poi però si ripresenta al suo negozio di musica l'ex compagna di liceo Vicky, da sempre ammirata, oggi più affascinante che mai. Per lei, Gabriel è disposto a tutto, persino a mentire su quanto ha di più caro.

programme.title: Un bambino per due
programme.desc: Le vite dei due conduttori televisivi Derrick e Layla vengono scombussolate da una neonata che "ereditano" in affidamento e della quale sono obbligati a occuparsi mentre si preparano per l'importante sfida professionale.

programme.title: Una corona per due
programme.desc: La storia d'amore tra Mandla e Riley sembra andare a gonfie vele. Quando Mandla invita Riley a conoscere i suoi genitori in Sudafrica, la ragazza scopre che il suo fidanzato è in realtà un principe. Triste e arrabbiata decide di lasciarlo e tornare a casa, ma Mandla farà di tutto per riconquistarla...

programme.title: Batti Cuore
programme.desc: La conduttrice Samantha Desouza è incaricata di presentare un programma che riunisce amori perduti. Anche se l'amore è l'ultima delle cose che ha in mente, Samantha finisce per cedere all'affascinante Jake, che chiama per risolvere un suo problema. Samantha seguirà per una volta il cuore?

programme.title: La Combinazione Perfetta
programme.desc: La professionista pianificatrice Gwen si impegna ad aiutare a mettere i tocchi finali al matrimonio della sua migliore amica. Ma quando viene abbinata al testimone Josh, una guida naturalistica, scopre che questo matrimonio potrebbe non essere così facile come pensava.

programme.title: Il Gala dell'Amore
programme.desc: Quando a Kate viene affidato il compito di pianificare la Garden Gala di sua madre, il più grande evento di celebrazione dell'anno, deve scendere a compromessi con il nuovo e contraddittorio manager del giardino botanico.

programme.title: C'era una volta a Shaw Bay
programme.desc: Quando la città costiera di Shaw Bay è minacciata da un riqualificazione, l'agente immobiliare Erin farà di tutto per salvarla. Entra in scena il bel Theo, un reale in cerca di una nuova proprietà. Il trucco è che sta nascondendo la parte reale.

programme.title: La mia versione dell'amore
programme.desc: Rebecca, un'esperta di immagine incredibilmente di successo che si specializza nel tirare fuori la migliore versione di se stessi, si trova di fronte alla sua sfida più formidabile in Clive, un ex calciatore affascinante ma molto radicato nelle sue abitudini.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack è uno scrittore in difficoltà i cui ideali di speranza sono stati soppressi dal rifiuto e dalla solitudine, ma la sua vita è destinata a cambiare in seguito all'incontro con Maria, una ragazza allegra e molto superstiziosa.

programme.title: Una moglie ideale
programme.desc: In questo sguardo oltraggiosamente divertente al matrimonio e alla sessualità negli anni '90, un uomo felicemente sposato convince la sua amorevole moglie ad aiutarlo a vivere la fantasia maschile definitiva.

programme.title: Sogno Di Una Notte Di Mezza Eta'
programme.desc: Daniel è felicemente sposato con sua moglie, ma ha due problemi: la sua fervida fantasia e il suo miglior amico Patrick, che durante una cena presenta agli amici la sua giovane “fiamma”, questo porterà Daniel a sognare ad occhi aperti e non distinguere la realtà dalla fantasia.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Quando Joel (Paul Rudd) e Molly (Amy Poehler) si incontrano, è odio a prima vista: la grande azienda produttrice di dolciumi di lui minaccia di far chiudere la piccola impresa indipendente di lei.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Delitto d'amore
programme.desc: Un dramma sociale diretto da Luigi Comencini ed interpretato da Stefania Sandrelli e Giuliano Gemma. Nullo e Carmela lavorano nella stessa fabbrica e s'innamorano ma, dopo che lei si ammala per alcune esalazioni tossiche, lui cerca vendetta.

programme.title: 11 Settembre
programme.desc: Un gruppo di 5 persone si trova intrappolato in un ascensore nella Torre Nord del World Trade Center l'undici settembre. Senza mai abbandonare la speranza, cerca di liberarsi e fuggire prima che accada l'impensabile.

programme.title: Ask me anything
programme.desc: Bella e giovane, Katie ha deciso di prendersi un anno di pausa prima di iniziare il college. Vorrebbe scoprire se stessa e andare oltre il suo noioso lavoro nella libreria locale e le giornate a fumare con il suo fidanzato. Ha intenzione di sedurre Dan, un professore trentaduenne del college.

programme.title: D-Day
programme.desc: War movie ad alta tensione con Randy Couture. D-Day, un'unità d'élite americana è incaricata di distruggere i cannoni nazisti a Pointe du Hoc. L'attacco alle imbarcazioni scatena una serie di eventi costringerà i soldati a combattere per giorni contro le forze tedesche.

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: Nicole vive con la madre e lavora part-time in una prigione, dove finalmente le viene data l'occasione per una promozione. Dovrà scortare Joan Anderson, una prigioniera indisciplinata, ad una visita alla madre morente.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: A Good Marriage
programme.desc: L'adattamento dell'omonimo racconto di Stephen King. Una donna di nome Darcy (Joan Allen) scopre la doppia vita che il marito sta vivendo da 25 anni. Dovrà decidere se mantenere o meno il suo rapporto con lui.

programme.title: Lanello perfetto
programme.desc: Proprietaria di una gioielleria, Kate disegna anelli di fidanzamento e fedi nuziali. Quando, un giorno, rivede il suo primo amore Jaimie, questi le offre di lavorare come stilista di gioielli in una grande casa di oreficeria.

programme.title: Chiedi Alla Polvere
programme.desc: Nella Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore italo-americano Arturo e la cameriera messicana Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere il romanzo della vita, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti.

programme.title: Senza santi in paradiso
programme.desc: Bob e Ruth sono una coppia di fuorilegge che vengono catturati dopo una sparatoria. Bob si prende la colpa dell'accaduto e Ruth viene rilasciata e porta avanti una gravidanza. Dopo quattro anni Bob evade per conoscere la figlia mai vista finora.

programme.title: Crazy kind of love
programme.desc: Quando la famiglia Moon deve affrontare una nuova, inattesa gravidanza, i fragili equilibri domestici vengono completamente stravolti. Il padre scompare, la madre deve ritrovare la sua identità, e i figli adolescenti si ritrovano a crescere in fretta.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: Lily è una giovane interior designer che abita a Seattle, ma è nata e cresciuta in un piccolo paese, dove sua zia Maggie gestisce un b&b. Avendo bisogno d'aiuto, Maggie chiama la nipote per aiutarla a gestire l'azienda. Lì incontra l'affascinante Marcus.

programme.title: Tutto si aggiusta Tutto si aggiusta
programme.desc: In Islanda per il suo matrimonio, Patrick scopre che la vita può cambiare quando meno te lo aspetti.

programme.title: Tutto si aggiusta
programme.desc: In Islanda per il suo matrimonio, Patrick scopre che la vita può cambiare quando meno te lo aspetti.

programme.title: Per amore di Valerie Per amore di Valerie
programme.desc: Florian e Valerie lavorano nello stesso albergo. Florian è innamorato di Valerie.

programme.title: Per amore di Valerie

programme.desc: L'avvocato Sarah Stein si occupa di un caso riguardante un'eredità ma tutti i famigliari litigano tra di loro.

programme.title: Vendemmia d'amore
programme.desc: L'avvocato Sarah Stein si occupa di un caso riguardante un'eredità ma tutti i famigliari litigano tra di loro.

programme.title: Un weekend d'agosto Un weekend d'agosto
programme.desc: Un incontro casuale con un affascinante sconosciuto capovolge il mondo perfetto di Katja.

programme.title: Un weekend d'agosto
programme.desc: Un incontro casuale con un affascinante sconosciuto capovolge il mondo perfetto di Katja.

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: Justine arriva con il neomarito alla festa delle nozze che il cognato e la sorella Claire le hanno organizzato con un ritmato protocollo. Justine sorride molto ma dentro di sé prova un disagio profondo che la spingerà ad allontanarsi in più occasioni dai festeggiamenti provocando lo sconcerto di molti, marito compreso. Non si tratta però solo di un malessere esistenziale privato. Una grave minaccia incombe sulla Terra: il pianeta Melancholia si sta avvicinando e, benché il mondo scientifico inviti all'ottimismo, il rischio di collisione e di distruzione totale del globo terrestre è più che mai realistico.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: Motel Woodstock
programme.desc: Il film racconta la storia di Tiber, un uomo comune che gestiva assieme ai genitori un motel, tenendo nascosta la propria omosessualità. Tiber fu l'uomo che riuscì a trovare il luogo adatto e le licenze necessarie per dar vita ad uno degli eventi che hanno segnato la storia della musica, del costume e non solo, il Festival di Woodstock.

programme.title: The greatest movie ever sold
programme.desc: Morgan Spurlock rivela il lato nascosto del mondo del marketing attaccando con grande umorismo la pubblicità illegittima nel cinema e in televisione attraverso il cosiddetto product placement.

programme.title: The greatest movie ever sold
programme.desc: Morgan Spurlock rivela il lato nascosto del mondo del marketing attaccando con grande umorismo la pubblicità illegittima nel cinema e in televisione attraverso il cosiddetto product placement.

programme.title: Un neomelodico presidente
programme.desc: Il cantante neomelodico Leopoldo Giappone, in arte Mimmo Dany, si candida a presidente della regione Campania con una lista a sé, l'UVC. Il suo sogno tuttavia resta quello di partecipare al reality show L'isola dei famosi, e per questo ha a che fare con la malavita.

programme.title: Strafumati
programme.desc: Dale Denton è un impiegato del tribunale che frequenta spesso uno spacciatore di nome Saul Silver per procurarsi marijuana. Saul ha a disposizione il meglio in materia e un giorno gli offre l'erba più esclusiva sul mercato: la Pineapple Express. E' così speciale che fumarla può far sentire in colpa come nell'uccidere un unicorno.

programme.title: Friends with Money
programme.desc: Il film esamina i mutevoli rapporti tra quattro donne la cui amicizia di lunga data è minacciata dalla crescente disparità del loro stato finanziario. Le tre amiche ricche, Frannie, Jane e Christine, condividono una preoccupazione per Olivia, che sembra incapace di guadagnarsi da vivere o di portare avanti una relazione, almeno per i loro standard.

programme.title: Peggy Sue si è sposata
programme.desc: Il film è la storia di Peggy Sue Bodell, una madre carina e vivace, divorziata da poco con due figli. Sviene durante la riunione della sua vecchia classe del liceo e si risveglia magicamente nell'anno 1959, il suo ultimo anno di liceo. Nonostante tutti la credano una 17enne, Peggy Sue conserva la sua memoria da adulta e sfrutterà questa occasione per vivere le esperienze che non ha mai vissuto e tentare di ricostruirsi un nuovo destino.

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: Warren Beatty e Dustin Hoffman trovano l'avventura, l'amore e il divertimento nella strada verso ISHTAR.

programme.title: I due crociati
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco, disastri tra Crociati e Saraceni, rovesciano per caso le sorti dello scontro finale.

programme.title: Il ras del quartiere
programme.desc: Domingo, capo di teppisti e custodi del quartiere, aiuta un uomo a cercare la figlia scappata di casa

programme.title: Le piacevoli notti di Justine
programme.desc: Nell'Ottocento, due attori girovaghi aprono un locale equivoco, sfidano il governatore

programme.title: Aragosta a colazione
programme.desc: Enrico fallisce il suicidio e finisce nei guai recitando la parte del marito per un amico

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Anni difficili
programme.desc: Con Umberto Spadaro, Massimo Girotti e Ave Ninchi, Aldo Piscitello deve aderire al Partito Fascista e affrontare la guerra. Tra doveri familiari e scelte morali, cerca il coraggio di restare fedele a sé stesso in un'Italia in crisi.

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: Accadde al commissariato
programme.desc: Compagnie teatrali sul lastrico, matrimoni in crisi, bambini abbandonati e oltraggi al senso del pudore, animano la vita dell'ufficio, impegnando il commissario, che vorrebbe trovare del tempo per dedicarsi alla sua nuova automobile.

programme.title: American Carnage
programme.desc: Una nuova legge permette l' arresto dei figli di immigrati irregolari. Per evitare il carcere i giovani hanno una sola opportunità: fare volontariato in una misteriosa casa di cura fornendo assistenza agli anziani.

programme.title: The Dentist
programme.desc: La vita del dr. Feinstone, un dentista di Beverly Hills, sembra apparentemente perfetta, ma in realtà nasconde un terribile segreto. Impazzito dopo il tradimento della moglie, infligge raccapriccianti torture ai suoi ignari pazienti.

programme.title: Ti presento Bill
programme.desc: Stufo della sua vita, Bill si ritrova mentore di un adolescente indisciplinato ma curiosamente saggio. Quando scopre il tradimento della moglie, Bill non ha più nulla da perdere e si rivolge al ragazzo come modello di ispirazione per cambiare la propria esistenza.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Ghost Academy
programme.desc: Un professore tormentato da allucinazioni di persone defunte, ottiene una cattedra per insegnare a una classe di soli cinque studenti. Ma gli alunni sono fantasmi, morti da più di vent'anni.

programme.title: Gatto nero, gatto bianco
programme.desc: Due giovani si vogliono bene, ma le loro famiglie si oppongono. È solo il pretesto per tutto il resto di questo film unico. Il Kusturica più vero, e Leone d'Argento a Venezia

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Il magnifico gladiatore
programme.desc: Diretto da Alfonso Brescia con Mark Forest, un gladiatore affronta tiranni e tradimenti in una Roma dominata dal potere.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Il Terrore dei Barbari
programme.desc: Tra invasioni, assedi e battaglie spettacolari, un eroe affronta orde barbariche per difendere il destino di Roma.

programme.title: Piena di Grazia
programme.desc: Dopo la resurrezione, Maria guida i discepoli tra dubbi e speranza custodendo il messaggio destinato a cambiare il mondo.

programme.title: Barabba
programme.desc: Liberato al posto di Gesù, il brigante Barabba vive tormentato dal dubbio su chi fosse davvero l'uomo condannato alla croce.

programme.title: Jesse & Lester
programme.sub-title: Due fratelli in un posto chiamato Trinità
programme.desc: Dopo aver ereditato un appezzamento di terreno in un luogo polveroso chiamato Trinity, i fratellastri antagonisti, Lester e Jesse, si riuniscono per perseguire aspirazioni diverse, solo per trovarsi nei guai fino al collo. Realizzeranno mai i loro sogni?

programme.title: La cavalcata della vendetta
programme.desc: Quando un capo indiano viene assassinato in una città odiosa, un ex sceriffo simpatizzante cerca di impedire agli indiani di attaccare per vendetta.

programme.title: Vaya con dios gringo
programme.desc: I fratelli Cris uccidono il fratello di Gringo e lo incastrano insieme al suo amico. In prigione, i veri assassini fuggono e rapiscono Carmen. Gringo affronta avventure pericolose per dimostrare la sua innocenza e salvarla.

programme.title: Di Tresette ce n'è uno, tutti gli altri son nessuno
programme.desc: Tresette, affiancato dal suo imponente compagno Paco, si trova coinvolto in una serie di scontri contro pericolosi pistoleri e membri del Ku Klux Klan. Tra duelli, imboscate e situazioni pericolose, i due affrontano avversari sempre più insidiosi in un contesto di violenza e ingiustizia.

programme.title: Per il gusto di uccidere
programme.desc: Hank Fellows è un cacciatore di taglie che si dedica anche al recupero del bottino che le bande di rapinatori rubano dalle banche.

programme.title: I sette del Texas
programme.desc: Il ricco texano Clifford, in viaggio per salvare la moglie, affronta minacce dai nativi.

programme.title: Faccia a faccia
programme.desc: Un professore di storia incrocia casualmente un noto fuorilegge e finisce per guidare la sua banda.

programme.title: Viva Gringo

programme.desc: 1976, è una calda serata tranquilla come le altre, quando una famiglia, una comunità ed un'intera nazione viene sconvolta da un terremoto terribile che causa la morte di più di 240.000 persone. Una madre si troverà di fronte ad una scelta difficile che cambierà la sua vita intera.

programme.title: A Special Lady
programme.desc: Una spietata donna ai vertici di un'organizzazione criminale tenta di cambiare vita per il figlio, ma il suo passato violento torna a distruggere tutto ciò che ama.

programme.desc: Il viaggio di un ex contrabbandiere che, uscito di prigione, cerca di cominciare una nuova vita da zero e di recuperare la relazione con suo fratello che gli è diventato estraneo.

programme.title: Il ritratto di una donna contro
programme.desc: Jane Austen, sognatrice ribelle, sfida le convenzioni per amore nell'Inghilterra del 1795.

programme.desc: Tyler e Ally, due cuori segnati dal dolore, trovano l'amore ma i segreti li separano.

programme.title: Duetto a tre
programme.desc: anley e Michael, durante un appuntamento, si ritrovano a trascorrere la serata con un barbone.

programme.title: Un'occasione da Dio
programme.desc: Gli alieni minacciano la Terra, ma danno a Neil Clarke il potere di salvarla.

programme.title: Deus: La sfera oscura
programme.desc: La Terra è sull'orlo di un disastro ambientale e la popolazione è salita a più di 20 miliardi.. Viene scoperta una sfera nera nell'orbita di Marte che inizia a trasmettere una parola in ciascuna delle lingue della Terra: Deus (Dio). L'astronave The Achilles è inviata ad indagare.

programme.title: 47 Metri
programme.desc: Una traversata aerea verso un atollo remoto si trasformerà in un vero incubo per 5 passeggeri nel momento in cui il veivolo precipita a 100 miglia di distanza dalla costa in un atollo infestato da squali.

programme.title: Incoming: Fuga dalla Prigione Orbitante
programme.desc: Una stazione spaziale internazionale è ora utilizzata come prigione senza via di scampo per i peggiori criminali. Un giorno, però, l'ordine viene capovolto e i terroristi detenuti prendono il controllo della struttura.

programme.title: Zero tolerance
programme.desc: Bangkok. Il corpo di una ragazza viene rinvenuto in un fiume. Un detective viene incaricato di condurre le indigini, ma la sua morale dovrà scontrarsi con un irrefrenabile sete di vendetta quando riconoscerà nel corpo senza vita Angela, la figlia del suo amico e compagno d'armi Johnny.

programme.title: The Last Days
programme.desc: Una misteriosa epidemia si diffonde in tutto il pianeta. L'umanità sviluppa una paura irrazionale per gli spazi aperti che porta alla morte immediata. Ben presto, la popolazione mondiale rimanente si ritroverà intrappolata all'interno degli edifici.

programme.title: Il Gioco Dell'inganno
programme.desc: Sophie, stilista in procinto di lanciare la sua prima linea di abbigliamento, trova uno dei suoi dipendenti assassinato. Una serie di spaventosi eventi la porta a realizzare che deve agire in fretta per salvare la sua vita.

programme.title: Immagini Sporche
programme.desc: Alexander 'Sasha' Shulgin è lo scienziato dietro più di 200 composti psichedelici tra cui l'MDMA, più comunemente noto come Ecstasy. Considerato uno dei più grandi chimici del ventesimo secolo, la vasta gamma di scoperte di Sasha ha avuto un profondo impatto nel campo della ricerca psichedelica.

programme.title: The Monster And The Ape
programme.desc: When a robot dubbed Metalogen Man is stolen by a giant ape, its creator goes on an epic quest to find it and the party responsible for its abduction.

programme.title: The Body Tree
programme.desc: When a group of Americans travel to Russian Siberia to honor the memory of their murdered friend, they uncover a plot that threatens all their lives

programme.title: Lethal Alligator
programme.desc: Una piccola squadra di soldati, cui si unisce una zoologa, viene mandata nel Nord di Los Angeles per occuparsi di un pericoloso coccodrillo gigante che sta terrorizzando la popolazione. Si dice che l'animale esca dall'acqua e uccida le persone poiché sia alla ricerca di alcune uova che gli sono state sottratte. La lotta per fermarlo sarà spietata.

programme.title: Blood Lake
programme.desc: Spaventose lamprede terrorizzano una tranquilla cittadina sul Lago Michigan e una comunità intera lotta per la sopravvivenza.

programme.title: Empire of the Sharks
programme.desc: Su una terra in cui il 98% della superficie è sott'acqua, un signore della guerra che controlla un esercito di squali incontra il suo più acerrimo nemico quando cattura la figlia di un misterioso cacciatore di squali.

programme.title: 5 headed shark attack
programme.desc: Lo squalo a 5 teste è tutto teste e denti. Questo furioso e bizzarro mostro terrorizza il mare aperto prima d'invadere le spiagge di Puerto Rico, mettendo in pericolo tutta la paradisiaca isola, un tempo pacifica. Chi sopravviverà?

programme.title: 6 headed shark attack
programme.desc: William, consulente matrimoniale, fonda un'organizzazione per coppie in crisi sull'isola di Corazon, al largo delle coste del Messico. Un giorno, durante un evento acquatico, i partecipanti vengono attaccati da uno squalo a sei teste.

programme.title: La camera dei misteri
programme.desc: Una madre e il suo giovane figlio liberano orrori inimmaginabili dalla soffitta casa di campagna.

programme.title: The Boy
programme.desc: Greta scopre che il "bambino" è una bambola, e un oscuro segreto minaccia la sua vita.

programme.title: The Lodge
programme.desc: Una giovane rimane sola con i figli del compagno nello chalet, dove riemergono traumi e oscure presenze.

programme.title: Il divoratore di ossa
programme.desc: Durante i lavori in Arizona, emerge un demone che scatena omicidi e lascia solo cadaveri disossati.

programme.title: Caccia al serial Killer
programme.desc: L'agente FBI Karl Helter e la partner Rebecca Lombardi indagano su un traffico sessuale e un serial killer.

programme.title: Giustizia finale
programme.desc: Gemelli omozigoti cercano di liberare Boston dagli uomini malvagi mentre sono braccati da un agente FBI.

programme.desc: Jonathan, poliziotto, affronta il suo passato traumatico nel quartiere maledetto.

programme.desc: Ramón, professore di filosofia, confessa il rapimento di Laura, una psichiatra.

programme.title: Viaggio nell'isola dei dinosauri
programme.desc: Una vacanza è l'evento di una vita quando un ragazzo arriva in un mondo di navi spettro e esseri primitivi

programme.title: End of the world: atto finale
programme.desc: Un gruppo di fan di film apocalittici deve utilizzare la sua conoscenza per salvare il mondo da una devastante eruzione solare
